component.name: Hot Wheels Turbo Racing: Recompiled
component.summary: Native port of Hot Wheels Turbo Racing built with static recompilation

description.p: A native build of the Nintendo 64 game Hot Wheels Turbo Racing, produced by statically recompiling the game's MIPS code to C and running it on N64ModernRuntime with the RT64 renderer. Requires your own copy of the USA ROM.
